title: go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin is deprecated
summary: The latest go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin module declares: "The zipkin exporter is deprecated and will be removed in early 2027. See the blog post "Deprecating Zipkin Exporter": https://opentelemetry.io/blog/2025/deprecating-zipkin-exporters/"

constraints: Keep go.mod and go.sum consistent: after the change no package should still require go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin, directly or through a replace directive.
go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin names no replacement module; pick a maintained alternative or accept the risk, and record the decision.

steps.title: Replace the deprecated module
steps.instructions: Replace the go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin requirement with a maintained alternative that fits how the project uses it, then run `go mod tidy`.

steps.title: Migrate imports and calls
steps.instructions: Update imports and calls of go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/zipkin in the reported files to the chosen alternative.

verification.purpose: Build and test every package without the deprecated module.

verification.command: go mod tidy && git diff --exit-code go.mod go.sum
verification.purpose: Confirm go.mod and go.sum are tidy after the replacement.
